conviction_note: Nothing found decides this Q3 print: the company has not revised a full-year plan mid-year since FY2021, the strategy news (new mid-term plan) is explicitly scheduled for 2027-01-14, and the two sourced facts that matter pull opposite ways -- an H1 that beat the company's own plan by 47.6% at operating profit with the year held (conservatism, small upward-revision optionality) against an IFIS Q3 operating-profit bar of 700m yen (+31% y/y) in a quarter the company itself guided soft for BPO with flat plot sales; findings sum +0.70, the scaled number is 53/47 on a 4.5% scale = +0.27, and the gap is because the findings are each sized alone while p_up carries the honest near-balance.
bar: IFIS consensus as shown on Monex 銘柄スカウター (snapshot 2026-07-13): Q3 (Jun-Aug 2026) revenue 6,730m yen, operating profit 700m, pretax 630m, net 400m; FY11/2026 OP 2,730m = company plan 2,733m (held 2026-07-14). https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/2471_20260714_act_20260714_153024_3 . Single source, possibly stale by three months and probably 1-2 analysts, so every size is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is on Q3 operating profit.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position >=0.5%, as of 2026-09-29, unchanged), source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline. 信用倍率 41.52x (kabutan page 2026-10-14, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2471) -- a crowded leveraged retail long that would supply sellers on a disappointment. Largest holder 光通信 group raised its stake 23.99% -> 24.72% (obligation date 2026-09-17, filed 2026-09-29), a steady accumulator and dip support. No skew exists. findings.finding: H1 FY11/2026 operating profit 648m yen beat the company's own H1 plan of 439m by +47.6% (sales +2.5%, gross margin +2.1pt over plan, despite an unplanned ~140m special bonus), yet the full-year plan of 2,733m was held 'as originally scheduled', which cuts the implied H2 from 2,294m to 2,085m and leaves room for Q3 cumulative progress ahead of prior years or an upward revision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 beat-and-hold print (2026-07-14) was followed by +3.4% (estimated-cadence baseline). At Q3 FY25 the company held a plan it later missed badly (OP 2,418 vs 3,070) and the stock still rose ~+4.7% on that Q3; kabutan's revision history shows no mid-year 修正 rows for FY2022-FY2026, so a Q3 revision would be out of character.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock rose on the H1 print and has since given it all back (273 at end-July, 304 on 08-20, 263 at the seal). If the market were pricing the conservatism as revision optionality the stock would not be at its post-print low going into Q3; if it were pricing a miss, the disclosed shorts would be building, and they are at zero.
findings.independence: Same company, different document: H1 briefing slide 7 shows the plan comparison and slide 3 says the profit target of the mid-term plan is unchanged (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592431.pdf). IFIS showed Q1 and Q2 both beating consensus (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/2471_20260414_act_20260414_153033_7).

findings.finding: The IFIS Q3 bar asks for operating profit of 700m yen, +31% on Q3 FY25's 535m and Q3 FY24's 538m, in a quarter where the company guided BPO revenue to 'settle temporarily as spot work runs off' and set Q3 farm-plot sales at 250-300 against 294 a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY26 OP 612m beat the IFIS Q2 bar of 547m and the stock rose ~+3.4%; Q1 FY26 beat the IFIS pretax bar by 77% and the stock fell ~-1.5% (both estimated-cadence moves from the baseline). The name does not reliably reward quarterly beats, so a quarterly miss is likely muted too.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company's soft-Q3 guidance and the 250-300 plot plan have been public since 2026-07-14 and anyone can compute the 進捗率. What is not visible is whether the sell side lifted Q3 after the H1 beat; Q2's underlying OP (612m + ~140m one-off bonus, ~+38% y/y) suggests 700m is attainable, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: Company's own guidance in the H1 briefing: BPO 'スポット業務の一巡により、3Qの売上は一時的に落ち着く見込み' and '[3Q]250-300区画' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592431.pdf); prior Q3 OP and plots from kabutan's quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2471) and the FY25 Q3 briefing ('3Q：294区画', https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251014573028.pdf).

findings.finding: Two further indoor farms were announced after H1 -- the 63rd (Osaka Nishiyodogawa, 276 plots, opening September 2026) and the 64th (Tokyo Hachioji, 204 plots, opening November 2026) -- against a full-year plan stated at H1 as '農園開設は3農園（屋内3）' with three indoor farms already opened in H1, which points to plot demand running ahead of plan after the statutory employment rate rose to 2.7% in July 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Plot sales above plan were the stated driver of the H1 beat (Q2 482 plots vs plan 405-455) and that print was followed by ~+3.4%. Q3 FY25 plots also beat plan (294 vs 215-265) and the stock rose ~+4.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Farm-opening press releases are not results and drew no visible price response (2026-08-21 close 300 -> 298; 2026-10-06 280 -> 270 next day). Whether the two extra farms are beyond plan rests on reading the H1 slide's full-year '3 farms' as including H1's three, which is an inference, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Separate document: the 63rd-farm release https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260821/140120260821524209.pdf; the H1 briefing slide 14-15 for the plan and H1 openings (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592431.pdf). Same company throughout, no counterparty confirmation.

findings.finding: 光通信 and its co-holders raised their stake from 23.99% to 24.72% (19.53m shares, obligation date 2026-09-17, filed 2026-09-29), the latest in a run of increases (No.18 March, No.19 April, No.20 June, No.21 September), a standing buyer under a 41.5x margin-long overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measurable reaction to the filings themselves; the stock has fallen from 304 to 263 while the accumulation continued.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and has not stopped the drift lower, so it is a cushion on a disappointment rather than a catalyst; sized as an asymmetry, not a direction.

outside_window.finding: The new mid-term plan with the growth strategy (disability-employment focus, portfolio review) is to be published with the FY11/2026 results on 2027-01-14, and founder 浦上壮平's resignation as representative director has no date yet; the strategic re-rating, and any FY27 guide, sit there, not at this Q3 print.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive against a priced lean of -0.66 (margin overhang) and a -6% five-day run-in, so they cut slightly against the baseline; the strongest positive the release could carry is an upward FY revision or a buyback, both looked for and both out of character for this company, which is why p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series/progress rate the market already has): the Q3-bar finding rests on public company guidance and a computable progress rate, so it was cut from -0.6 to -0.4; p_up was already near 50 and stays at 53.
Rule 2 (check the strongest positive): looked for a revision, a buyback and a dividend change; none is signalled, recorded in baseline_tension; nothing else moved.
